title: 64x Vanilla World Gen
description: Biomes are sixty-four times the width of vanilla. Effectively one biome per world.
body:
# 64x Vanilla World Gen

At this scale, a single biome can stretch for tens of thousands of blocks. Finding where it ends is an adventure in itself.

## Features
- All 5 climate parameters scaled: temperature, vegetation, continentalness, erosion, and weirdness
- Biomes 64x wider than vanilla, sixteen times the size of Large Biomes
- Normal world type (no presets required)
- Part of the Vanilla World Gen series: 2x · 4x · 8x · 16x · 32x · 64x

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Create a new world (Normal type)
3. Load in. Only affects ungenerated chunks.

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack, no mods, no executables
